lineage_discontinuity.statement: R5 asks a new prospective token-to-realized-delta transfer question and cannot promote, patch, or reinterpret R4 into a pass.

historical_authority.r4_status: byte-valid and computationally replayable packet whose scientific admission instrument failed support and had an algebraically impossible raw rank target

research_question: Does unchanged V2 public token/action/organism history support conservative reuse of anonymous source mappings while retaining scratch and one-swap local-shift alternatives, first at fixed-packet encounter inference and then through the sole primitive-action path?

facts: R4 raw rank 15 is algebraically impossible because bias equals the sum of exhaustive front-token indicators.
R4 outcome_type is perfectly decoded in-sample by public action plus front_token.
Interacted organism response depends on a private seed-specific visible-token permutation.
The production command schema has no selected-action override.
The current controller has no source-bank import.
inferences: The relevant transfer surface is public token-to-organism mechanism reuse and rejection, not outcome-category diagnosis.
assumptions: Complete non-clipped public source interactions recover the common five anonymous mechanism prototypes.
unknowns: Encounter headroom, equal-access baseline non-equivalence, primitive-action feasibility, and any fresh held-out effect.

seed_firewall.replacement_heldout_rule: After implementation, thresholds, and development verdict are frozen, a process outside the implementation lineage must select and commitment-hash a block wholly above world 150 and give implementation only opaque run handles and public rows.

run_id_grammars.visibility: verifier_only; no run-ID bytes or hashes enter a learner

single_real_path: PlaygroundController.dispatch -> engine.compute_step -> predictive_control.plan_action -> survival_learning.select_action -> transition_world -> compute_metabolism_ledger -> predictive_control.update_after_transition -> SQLite append/recover

realized_delta_contract.conditional_exception: Only a later row-by-row equality verifier may establish equivalence for a row.
realized_delta_contract.scorer_semantics: The same public realized post-minus-pre delta, including metabolism and clipping.

verifier_only_provenance: world, layout, policy, run, split, class, and source IDs
code, dependency, artifact, and payload hashes
forbidden_arm_inputs: world, layout, policy, run, split, target-class, distance, or source identity
private token mapping, cause, or objects_by_cause
observation beyond the committed current transition
candidate metric, verdict, support-pass state, or adaptive stopping flag
full-state, trace, command, run, payload, or artifact hash alias

source_bank.advance_rule: Advance after first successful fully non-clipped interact row for requested token.
source_bank.aggregate_unit: one anonymous mapping per source world, validated by both policy runs
admission: all five tokens have a successful fully non-clipped row in every run
both policy runs for a world recover identical mappings
each source mapping is a bijection
all sources expose the same set of five distinct public prototypes
source_bank.prototype_recovery: For fully non-clipped interactions, canonical six-decimal z=realized_delta-base_increment.
source_bank.prototype_id: lowercase sha256 hex of canonical public four-vector bytes, with no cause name
source_bank.canonicalization: Python half-even round(float,6), normalize negative zero to 0.0, UTF-8 JSON list with separators comma/colon, lowercase SHA-256 hex
source_bank.mapping_order: tokens v0..v4; six mappings sorted by canonical mapping bytes
source_bank.fully_non_clipped_predicate: action interact, outcome interacted, pre visual[1][2] in v0..v4, and every post-organism component strictly between 0 and 1
source_bank.replicate_agreement: exact equality of five canonical token/prototype_id pairs
source_bank.data_hash_phase: Bind actual source trace/state/payload hashes after implementation freeze in a separate pre-target provenance gate.

stage1_fixed_packet_inference.packet_generation: Private scorer, unchanged transition semantics, canonical organism S=[0.45,0.62,0.50,0.43], lexical token presentation v0..v4
stage1_fixed_packet_inference.packet_rule: Every inference method receives byte-identical prefix rows.
stage1_fixed_packet_inference.endpoint_scorer: Reset an independent deep-copy organism to canonical S for every token.

stage2_primitive_acquisition.purpose: isolate and cross inference with active acquisition on the sole controller path
stage2_primitive_acquisition.history_rule: Each arm starts from the same paired checkpoint and generates its own legal history; no common packet or forced action is injected.
stage2_primitive_acquisition.scorer: After checkpoint freeze, query each frozen learner at public canonical S=[0.45,0.62,0.50,0.43] and evaluate every token on an independent deep copy reset to S; never use the arm checkpoint organism; no truth/update returns to arm; all S+base+prototype components are interior so truth is unclipped base+prototype.

stage_firewall.scorer_write_order: seal learner-public bytes, then write verifier-private scorer envelope

common_navigation_adapter.observation: canonical public schema/version and 5x5 visual only
common_navigation_adapter.cell_schema: rows {x,y,value} sorted by (y,x); value empty/wall/v0..v4; omitted means unknown
common_navigation_adapter.observation_projection: skip center/self and occluded; dx=column-2,dy=row-2; rotate N:(dx,dy), E:(-dy,dx), S:(-dx,-dy), W:(dy,-dx); add pose; overwrite with post observation; then unconditionally write current relative-pose cell as empty
common_navigation_adapter.pose_update: own committed turned/moved outcome only; blocked move does not move pose
common_navigation_adapter.bfs_edges: turns cost1; forward cost1 only into known empty; edge iteration follows primitive_tie_order
common_navigation_adapter.known_target_rule: goal is a known empty cell adjacent to observed desired-token cell and facing it; shortest sequence then lexicographically smallest full action sequence
common_navigation_adapter.frontier_rule: directed edge from known empty into omitted/unknown; rank by shortest turn/move distance then (y,x,facing_index); append one move_forward probe
common_navigation_adapter.already_front_rule: if visual[1][2] is desired token, interact
common_navigation_adapter.candidate_scores: all five actions; float 1.0 selected and 0.0 otherwise
common_navigation_adapter.selector_boundary: exact candidate_scores into existing sole survival_learning.select_action with learning mode off; unique 1.0 action must be returned
common_navigation_adapter.life_reset: navigation state resets to initial; learner posterior, query counts, and latched desired token persist within arm run
common_navigation_adapter.step_count: increments once per committed primitive action and is not a model/acquisition threshold

finite_reference.prototype_table_access: shared identically by all 120-space arms including structure-matched scratch
finite_reference.transfer_advantage_under_test: source mapping-prior reuse, not prototype-catalog discovery
finite_reference.mapping_space: all 5! = 120 bijections from v0..v4 to public prototype IDs
finite_reference.mapping_order: itertools.permutations of prototype IDs sorted by canonical vector bytes, assigned to tokens v0..v4

serialized_state.normalization: retain unnormalized family-by-mapping joint masses and normalize once over total mixture evidence
serialized_state.non_scratch_zero_family: allowed; set family posterior and all joint cells to zero; emit diagnostic {row_index,family,all_zero:true}; no failure
serialized_state.instrument_invalid_zero_case: total mixture evidence zero, equivalently full-support scratch evidence zero; do not mutate or smooth before dispatch

finite_reference.duplicate_rule: Accumulate duplicate mapping mass; normalize every family to one before applying family mass.
finite_reference.likelihood: 1 iff all four predicted post components exactly equal canonical six-decimal observed post components; otherwise 0
finite_reference.posterior_update: exact normalized multiplication with canonical sorted accumulation
finite_reference.bma_distribution: posterior mixture of deterministic realized deltas
finite_reference.bma_point_prediction: componentwise posterior mean rounded to six decimals

mdl.definition: MDL_b=-log2(Z_b), where Z_b is sequential marginal likelihood

primary_acquisition.criterion: exact I(pi;Y_token|legal_history) in bits over unique mapping and finite outcome partition

finite_reference.evsi_role: separately reported challenger with no normative role

mandatory_transfer_controls: structure-matched scratch Bayes: same 120 mappings, likelihood, BMA, EIG, access, compute, memory, and scorer; uniform prior only

consistency-set eliminator: exact source multiset elimination; equal-entry mapping distribution with duplicate multiplicity if nonempty, exact scratch posterior if empty; no three-family BMA or MDL; EIG/passive/uniform acquisition cells use this distribution
sham source bank using deterministic cyclic token rotation v0<-v1<-v2<-v3<-v4<-v0

matched-capacity scratch-local: first six normative lexicographic mappings as target/source-independent anchors plus their sixty ordered one-swap components; same 1/3 masses and likelihood; EIG under own posterior; no source-derived mass
hard best-source reuse: minimize cumulative four-component public post-organism MAE across successful rows, tie canonical mapping bytes, no scratch fallback, passive acquisition
uniform source averaging: equal-entry six-source prediction, target evidence never changes weights, passive acquisition

registered_ids.deferred_challenger_rule: Lookup/count/transition/successor/FSM/episodic challengers require exact new registered IDs and callable contracts in the later implementation card before pre-run provenance.

acquisition_contract.decision_times: once at arm start and only after a successful desired-token interaction
acquisition_contract.passive: lexical token among minimum successful-query count
acquisition_contract.uniform_eligible_set: tokens at minimum successful-query count, sorted lexical
acquisition_contract.uniform_replacement: without replacement until all five counts tie; balanced replacement thereafter
acquisition_contract.posterior_sampling: inverse-CDF sample one mapping in normative order; among minimum-count tokens maximize MAE(sampled four-vector,current posterior-mean four-vector), tie lexical

rng_contract.digest: SHA256(UTF8(task_id + U+001F + stage_id + U+001F + control_id + U+001F + decimal_draw_index))
rng_contract.legacy_fixed_quota_exception: Historical seed semantics retained and reported separately.

endpoint.metric: equal-weight MAE over five tokens times four public realized-delta components

effect_scale_derivation.source: immutable environment CAUSE_DELTAS only; no target mapping or result

endpoint.margin_status: Preregistered substantive value choices, not power-derived confidence bounds: one-quarter and one-twentieth of a typical mechanism separation.
endpoint.stage1_joint_rule: Target 81 passes benefit and every target 76..80 passes mismatch margin.
endpoint.stage2_joint_rule: Both target-81 policy pairs pass benefit and all ten target-76..80 policy pairs pass mismatch margin separately.
endpoint.source_deletion_requirement: Delete source and source-derived shift mass; true-analogy benefit must decrease by at least 0.021875 and fail the benefit rule.
endpoint.information_ablation_scope: Stage2 only; Stage1 has no acquisition claim.
endpoint.information_ablation_requirement: Before budget 2 change at least one non-tie query and worsen target-81 MAE by at least 0.004375 or increase worst mismatch regret by at least 0.004375.
endpoint.budget2_rationale: Two distinct observed tokens leave three of five assignments unresolved, retaining both positive-transfer and negative-transfer risk.

trace_replay_requirements: serialize or hash-bind priors, consistency masks, likelihood increments, marginal likelihoods, posterior masses, BMA distributions and means
serialize or hash-bind MDL receipts, 5% benefit quantiles, EIG partitions and values, desired tokens, primitive score surfaces, sole-selector receipts, updates, and scorer receipts
replay recomputes behavior before reading stored outputs
stored selected action is never a replay input
source-order permutation leaves values and choices unchanged
leakage_positive_controls: world, layout, policy, run, source, split, class, and distance IDs
full-state, trace, command, run, payload, and artifact hash aliases

stage2_overall_first_true: CONSERVATIVE_TRANSFER_PRIMITIVE_PATH_INFEASIBLE if any required pair cannot reach checkpoint 2 under caps
CONSERVATIVE_TRANSFER_NO_LEGAL_HEADROOM if checkpoints are reached but joint effect or ablation fails

quarantined_future_primitive_predictor_i.historical_note: A future R4-style multinomial predictor would need intercept plus front_empty reference coding, an exact gauge, and separately feasible rank/support gates; those are not scored by this 120-mapping reference.

source_import_dependency: A later implementation card must authorize one schema-validated, hash-bound source-bank import at the existing controller/engine initial-state boundary; no second reducer or action path.
provenance_phase_rule: Freeze normative card/design bytes first; bind actual source, dependency, test, code-path, and artifact hashes only after later implementation in a separate pre-run provenance gate.
claim_ceiling: Local docs-only prospective design freeze with explicitly contaminated development lineage; no computed headroom, implementation, controller-path effect, adaptation, survival improvement, fresh held-out result, product readiness, AGI, agency, consciousness, subjective experience, or electronic-life evidence.
